ko.title: 35%에서 60%로: Warsh의 강경파 Jackson Hole 연설이 월스트리트의 금리 베팅을 하루아침에 뒤집다

segments.src: ## A Jackson Hole Surprise Nobody Priced In
segments.tr: ## 누구도 예상하지 못한 Jackson Hole의 깜짝 뉴스

segments.src: Heading into last week's Jackson Hole Economic Symposium, most traders had a simple story in their heads: inflation was cooling, the labor market was softening, and the Federal Reserve was on a glide path toward cutting interest rates at its September meeting.
segments.tr: 지난주 Jackson Hole 경제 심포지엄을 앞두고, 대부분의 트레이더들은 머릿속에 간단한 시나리오를 그리고 있었습니다: 인플레이션이 진정되고 있고, 노동시장이 약화되고 있으며, 연방준비제도이사회는 9월 회의에서 금리를 인하할 수 있는 안정적인 경로에 있다는 것이었습니다.

segments.src: Futures markets reportedly had the odds of a rate hike at roughly 35%, with many desks treating that figure as a formality more than a real risk.
segments.tr: 선물 시장에 따르면 금리 인상 확률은 약 35% 수준이었으며, 많은 트레이딩 데스크들은 이 수치를 실질적인 위험보다는 형식적인 것으로 취급했습니다.

segments.src: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh tore that script up.
segments.tr: 연방준비제도 의장 Kevin Warsh는 그 시나리오를 완전히 뒤집어버렸습니다.

segments.src: In his keynote address at the symposium, Warsh struck a notably hawkish tone, describing recent inflation readings as "concerning" and telling the audience of central bankers, economists, and investors that the Fed "will have work to do" before it can declare victory over price pressures.
segments.tr: 심포지엄의 기조 연설에서 Warsh는 눈에 띄게 강경한 톤을 취했습니다. 최근 인플레이션 수치를 "우려스럽다"고 표현했고, 중앙은행가·경제학자·투자자들로 구성된 청중에게 연방준비제도이사회가 물가 압력에 대해 승리를 선언하기 전에 "할 일이 남아 있다"고 말했습니다.

segments.src: The remarks were widely interpreted as a signal that the central bank is far less comfortable with the current inflation trajectory than markets had assumed — and possibly open to tightening policy further rather than easing it.
segments.tr: 이 발언은 중앙은행이 시장이 가정했던 것보다 현재의 인플레이션 궤적에 훨씬 덜 만족스러워하고 있다는 신호로 널리 해석되었으며, 정책을 완화하기보다는 한층 더 긴축할 가능성도 있다는 의미로 받아들여졌습니다.

segments.src: ## Rate Bets Flip in a Matter of Hours
segments.tr: ## 금리 베팅이 몇 시간 만에 뒤바뀌다

segments.src: The market reaction was swift.
segments.tr: 시장의 반응은 신속했습니다.

segments.src: According to trading desks tracking interest-rate futures, the implied probability of a September rate hike jumped from around 35% to roughly 60% in the hours following the speech — a dramatic repricing for a market that, just a week earlier, had been leaning toward cuts.
segments.tr: 금리 선물을 추적하는 트레이딩 데스크들의 분석에 따르면, 연설 후 몇 시간 안에 9월 금리 인상의 내재적 확률이 약 35%에서 약 60%로 뛰어올랐습니다 — 불과 일주일 전까지만 해도 인하 쪽으로 기울고 있던 시장에 있어서 극적인 재평가였습니다.

segments.src: Equities moved in the opposite direction.
segments.tr: 주식은 반대 방향으로 움직였습니다.

segments.src: Major U.S.
segments.tr: 주요 미국

segments.src: stock indexes slipped as investors digested the prospect of tighter-for-longer monetary policy, with rate-sensitive sectors such as technology and real estate said to be among the hardest hit.
segments.tr: 주식 지수들은 투자자들이 더 오래 지속될 긴축 통화 정책의 전망을 소화하면서 하락했으며, 기술주와 부동산 같은 금리 민감 부문이 가장 큰 타격을 받은 것으로 알려졌습니다.

segments.src: Short-dated Treasury yields, which move closely with rate expectations, climbed as bond traders scrambled to adjust their positioning.
segments.tr: 금리 기대치와 밀접하게 움직이는 단기 국채 수익률이 채권 트레이더들이 자신의 포지션을 조정하기 위해 서두르면서 올라갔습니다.

segments.src: Analysts described the move as one of the more abrupt sentiment shifts of the year, noting that it underscores how quickly market narratives can unravel when a single speech contradicts the prevailing consensus.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 이 움직임을 올해 가장 급격한 심리 변화 중 하나로 평가했으며, 한 번의 연설이 지배적인 합의에 모순될 때 시장의 서사가 얼마나 빠르게 무너질 수 있는지를 보여준다고 지적했습니다.

segments.src: ## Why Warsh's Words Carry Extra Weight
segments.tr: ## Warsh의 발언이 남다른 영향력을 가지는 이유

segments.src: Because the Fed chair's public remarks are scrutinized for clues about the future path of monetary policy, even carefully hedged language can move markets.
segments.tr: 연방준비제도 의장의 공개 발언이 통화 정책의 미래 방향에 대한 단서를 찾기 위해 면밀히 검토되기 때문에, 신중하게 다듬어진 표현도 시장을 움직일 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Investors and economists parse word choice, tone, and emphasis for signs of where the committee's thinking is heading — and Warsh's use of terms like "concerning" landed as a clear departure from the more measured, data-dependent language markets had grown used to.
segments.tr: 투자자와 경제학자들은 위원회가 어디로 향하고 있는지에 대한 신호를 찾기 위해 단어 선택·톤·강조를 분석합니다 — 그리고 Warsh의 "우려스럽다"와 같은 표현은 시장이 익숙해진 더 신중하고 데이터 기반의 언어와의 명확한 이탈로 받아들여졌습니다.

segments.src: Some strategists cautioned against overreacting to a single speech, pointing out that the Fed's actual September decision will still hinge on incoming inflation and employment data released in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: 일부 전략가들은 한 번의 연설에 과민 반응하지 말 것을 경고했으며, 연방준비제도이사회의 실제 9월 결정은 향후 몇 주 동안 발표될 인플레이션과 고용 데이터에 달려 있을 것이라고 지적했습니다.

segments.src: Others argued that Warsh's tone reflects a genuine shift in the committee's internal debate, with more officials reportedly growing wary that inflation progress has stalled.
segments.tr: 한편 다른 관찰자들은 Warsh의 톤이 위원회의 내부 논의에서 실질적인 변화를 반영하고 있다고 주장했으며, 더 많은 관리들이 인플레이션 진전이 정체되었다는 점에 점점 더 우려를 품고 있는 것으로 보도되었습니다.

segments.src: ## What Investors Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## 투자자들이 다음으로 주목하는 것

segments.src: With rate-hike odds now nearly split with expectations for a hold, attention turns to the next batch of economic reports — particularly consumer price and jobs data — which could either reinforce or unwind the market's new hawkish lean.
segments.tr: 금리 인상 확률이 현재 유지 기대치와 거의 반반인 상황에서, 관심은 다음 배치의 경제 보고서—특히 소비자 물가와 고용 데이터—로 쏠리고 있으며, 이들은 시장의 새로운 강경파 성향을 강화하거나 풀어낼 수 있습니다.

segments.src: Traders are also expected to parse comments from other Fed officials in the coming days for signs of whether Warsh's view reflects broader consensus on the committee or a more personal emphasis.
segments.tr: 트레이더들은 또한 향후 며칠 동안 다른 연방준비제도 관리들의 발언을 분석하여 Warsh의 관점이 위원회의 보다 광범위한 합의를 반영하는지, 아니면 더 개인적인 강조인지를 파악하려 할 것으로 예상됩니다.

segments.src: For everyday investors, the episode is a reminder of how sensitive markets remain to Fed communication, and how quickly rate expectations — and portfolio values — can shift on a single speech.
segments.tr: 개인 투자자들에게 이 사건은 시장이 연방준비제도 통신에 얼마나 민감하게 반응하는지, 그리고 금리 기대치와 포트폴리오 가치가 한 번의 연설로 얼마나 빠르게 변할 수 있는지를 보여주는 사례입니다.

segments.src: As always, market-implied probabilities are estimates based on trading activity, not guarantees of the Fed's eventual decision, and conditions can change quickly as new data arrives.
segments.tr: 항상 그렇듯이, 시장이 함축한 확률은 거래 활동에 기반한 추정일 뿐 연방준비제도의 최종 결정을 보장하는 것이 아니며, 새로운 데이터가 도착하면서 상황은 빠르게 변할 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## A Jackson Hole Surprise Nobody Priced In
segments.tr: ## 一个没有人预价的杰克逊霍尔惊喜

segments.src: Heading into last week's Jackson Hole Economic Symposium, most traders had a simple story in their heads: inflation was cooling, the labor market was softening, and the Federal Reserve was on a glide path toward cutting interest rates at its September meeting.
segments.tr: 走进上周的杰克逊霍尔经济研讨会，大多数交易员心中都有一个简单的故事：通货膨胀正在降温，劳动力市场正在走软，联邦储备委员会正稳步走上9月会议削减利率的道路。

segments.src: Futures markets reportedly had the odds of a rate hike at roughly 35%, with many desks treating that figure as a formality more than a real risk.
segments.tr: 期货市场据称将加息的几率设定在大约35%左右，许多交易台将这一数字视为形式而非真正的风险。

segments.src: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh tore that script up.
segments.tr: 美联储主席凯文·沃什推翻了这个故事。

segments.src: In his keynote address at the symposium, Warsh struck a notably hawkish tone, describing recent inflation readings as "concerning" and telling the audience of central bankers, economists, and investors that the Fed "will have work to do" before it can declare victory over price pressures.
segments.tr: 在研讨会的主旨演讲中，沃什采取了明显的鹰派立场，将最近的通胀数据描述为"令人担忧的"，并告诉中央银行家、经济学家和投资者观众，美联储在宣布战胜价格压力前"还有工作要做"。

segments.src: The remarks were widely interpreted as a signal that the central bank is far less comfortable with the current inflation trajectory than markets had assumed — and possibly open to tightening policy further rather than easing it.
segments.tr: 这些言论被广泛解读为一个信号，即中央银行对当前通胀轨迹的态度远不如市场所假设的那样乐观——而且可能倾向于进一步收紧政策，而不是放松政策。

segments.src: ## Rate Bets Flip in a Matter of Hours
segments.tr: ## 利率押注在数小时内翻转

segments.src: The market reaction was swift.
segments.tr: 市场反应迅速。

segments.src: According to trading desks tracking interest-rate futures, the implied probability of a September rate hike jumped from around 35% to roughly 60% in the hours following the speech — a dramatic repricing for a market that, just a week earlier, had been leaning toward cuts.
segments.tr: 根据追踪利率期货的交易台，9月加息的隐含概率在演讲后的数小时内从大约35%跃升至约60%——对于一个仅在一周前还倾向于降息的市场来说，这是一次戏剧性的重新定价。

segments.src: Equities moved in the opposite direction.
segments.tr: 股票向相反方向移动。

segments.src: Major U.S.
segments.tr: 美国主要

segments.src: stock indexes slipped as investors digested the prospect of tighter-for-longer monetary policy, with rate-sensitive sectors such as technology and real estate said to be among the hardest hit.
segments.tr: 股票指数下滑，因为投资者消化了长期货币政策收紧的前景，技术和房地产等对利率敏感的板块据说受到了最严重的打击。

segments.src: Short-dated Treasury yields, which move closely with rate expectations, climbed as bond traders scrambled to adjust their positioning.
segments.tr: 与利率预期密切相关的短期国债收益率也上升了，因为债券交易员争相调整头寸。

segments.src: Analysts described the move as one of the more abrupt sentiment shifts of the year, noting that it underscores how quickly market narratives can unravel when a single speech contradicts the prevailing consensus.
segments.tr: 分析师将这一动作描述为今年更加突然的情绪转变之一，指出当单一演讲与主流共识相矛盾时，市场叙事可以多么迅速地崩溃。

segments.src: ## Why Warsh's Words Carry Extra Weight
segments.tr: ## 为什么沃什的言论有额外的分量

segments.src: Because the Fed chair's public remarks are scrutinized for clues about the future path of monetary policy, even carefully hedged language can move markets.
segments.tr: 由于美联储主席的公开言论被审视以寻找未来货币政策方向的线索，即使是谨慎措辞的语言也可能影响市场。

segments.src: Investors and economists parse word choice, tone, and emphasis for signs of where the committee's thinking is heading — and Warsh's use of terms like "concerning" landed as a clear departure from the more measured, data-dependent language markets had grown used to.
segments.tr: 投资者和经济学家分析措辞选择、语气和重点，以寻找委员会思路走向的迹象——沃什使用"令人担忧的"等措辞，与市场习惯的更加谨慎、数据依赖的语言形成了明显的反差。

segments.src: Some strategists cautioned against overreacting to a single speech, pointing out that the Fed's actual September decision will still hinge on incoming inflation and employment data released in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: 一些策略师告诫不要对单一演讲反应过度，指出美联储9月的实际决定仍将取决于未来数周公布的通胀和就业数据。

segments.src: Others argued that Warsh's tone reflects a genuine shift in the committee's internal debate, with more officials reportedly growing wary that inflation progress has stalled.
segments.tr: 其他人则认为，沃什的语气反映了委员会内部辩论的真正转变，据报道更多官员对通胀进展停滞感到警惕。

segments.src: ## What Investors Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## 投资者接下来关注什么

segments.src: With rate-hike odds now nearly split with expectations for a hold, attention turns to the next batch of economic reports — particularly consumer price and jobs data — which could either reinforce or unwind the market's new hawkish lean.
segments.tr: 随着加息几率现在几乎与按兵不动的预期平分秋色，关注焦点转向下一批经济数据——特别是消费者价格和就业数据——这些数据可能会强化或削弱市场新的鹰派立场。

segments.src: Traders are also expected to parse comments from other Fed officials in the coming days for signs of whether Warsh's view reflects broader consensus on the committee or a more personal emphasis.
segments.tr: 交易员还需要在未来数天解析其他美联储官员的评论，以判断沃什的观点是反映委员会的更广泛共识还是更个人化的强调。

segments.src: For everyday investors, the episode is a reminder of how sensitive markets remain to Fed communication, and how quickly rate expectations — and portfolio values — can shift on a single speech.
segments.tr: 对于普通投资者来说，这一事件是一个提醒：市场对美联储沟通的敏感程度如此之高，以及利率预期——和投资组合价值——可以因一场演讲而迅速改变。

segments.src: As always, market-implied probabilities are estimates based on trading activity, not guarantees of the Fed's eventual decision, and conditions can change quickly as new data arrives.
segments.tr: 一如既往，市场隐含的概率是基于交易活动的估计，而非美联储最终决定的保证，随着新数据的到来，情况可能会迅速变化。

segments.tr: फ्यूचर्स बाजारों में कथित रूप से दर वृद्धि की संभावना लगभग 35% थी, कई डेस्क इस आंकड़े को एक वास्तविक जोखिम से अधिक औपचारिकता के रूप में मान रहे थे।

es.title: Del 35% al 60%: Cómo el discurso halcón de Warsh en Jackson Hole volcó las apuestas sobre tasas de Wall Street durante la noche

segments.src: ## A Jackson Hole Surprise Nobody Priced In
segments.tr: ## Una sorpresa en Jackson Hole que nadie valuó

segments.src: Heading into last week's Jackson Hole Economic Symposium, most traders had a simple story in their heads: inflation was cooling, the labor market was softening, and the Federal Reserve was on a glide path toward cutting interest rates at its September meeting.
segments.tr: Entrando en el Simposio Económico de Jackson Hole de la semana pasada, la mayoría de los operadores tenían una historia simple en sus cabezas: la inflación se estaba enfriando, el mercado laboral se estaba debilitando, y la Reserva Federal se encaminaba a reducir las tasas de interés en su reunión de septiembre.

segments.src: Futures markets reportedly had the odds of a rate hike at roughly 35%, with many desks treating that figure as a formality more than a real risk.
segments.tr: Los mercados de futuros le asignaban probabilidades de aproximadamente 35% a un aumento de tasas, con muchos escritorios considerando esa cifra como una formalidad antes que como un riesgo real.

segments.src: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh tore that script up.
segments.tr: El presidente de la Fed Kevin Warsh rompió ese guión.

segments.src: In his keynote address at the symposium, Warsh struck a notably hawkish tone, describing recent inflation readings as "concerning" and telling the audience of central bankers, economists, and investors that the Fed "will have work to do" before it can declare victory over price pressures.
segments.tr: En su discurso de apertura en el simposio, Warsh adoptó un tono notablemente halcón, describiendo los recientes datos de inflación como "preocupantes" y diciéndole a la audiencia de banqueros centrales, economistas e inversores que la Fed "tendrá trabajo por hacer" antes de que pueda declarar victoria sobre las presiones de precios.

segments.src: The remarks were widely interpreted as a signal that the central bank is far less comfortable with the current inflation trajectory than markets had assumed — and possibly open to tightening policy further rather than easing it.
segments.tr: Las observaciones fueron ampliamente interpretadas como una señal de que el banco central está mucho menos satisfecho con la trayectoria de inflación actual de lo que los mercados habían asumido — y posiblemente abierto a endurecer la política aún más en lugar de flexibilizarla.

fr.title: De 35% à 60% : Comment le discours faucon de Warsh à Jackson Hole a retourné les paris sur les taux de Wall Street du jour au lendemain

segments.src: ## A Jackson Hole Surprise Nobody Priced In
segments.tr: ## Une surprise de Jackson Hole que personne n'avait anticipée

segments.src: Heading into last week's Jackson Hole Economic Symposium, most traders had a simple story in their heads: inflation was cooling, the labor market was softening, and the Federal Reserve was on a glide path toward cutting interest rates at its September meeting.
segments.tr: À l'approche du Symposium économique de Jackson Hole de la semaine dernière, la plupart des traders se racontaient une histoire simple : l'inflation refroidissait, le marché du travail s'affaiblissait, et la Réserve fédérale était sur une trajectoire vers une réduction des taux d'intérêt lors de sa réunion de septembre.

segments.src: Futures markets reportedly had the odds of a rate hike at roughly 35%, with many desks treating that figure as a formality more than a real risk.
segments.tr: Les marchés à terme avaient apparemment les cotes d'une hausse de taux à environ 35%, de nombreux bureaux de négociation considérant ce chiffre comme une formalité plutôt qu'un vrai risque.

segments.src: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh tore that script up.
segments.tr: Le président de la Fed Kevin Warsh a déchiré ce scénario.

segments.src: In his keynote address at the symposium, Warsh struck a notably hawkish tone, describing recent inflation readings as "concerning" and telling the audience of central bankers, economists, and investors that the Fed "will have work to do" before it can declare victory over price pressures.
segments.tr: Dans son discours d'ouverture au symposium, Warsh a adopté un ton nettement faucon, décrivant les dernières lectures d'inflation comme « préoccupantes » et disant à l'audience de banquiers centraux, d'économistes et d'investisseurs que la Fed « aura du travail à faire » avant de pouvoir déclarer la victoire sur les pressions de prix.

segments.src: The remarks were widely interpreted as a signal that the central bank is far less comfortable with the current inflation trajectory than markets had assumed — and possibly open to tightening policy further rather than easing it.
segments.tr: Les remarques ont été largement interprétées comme un signal que la banque centrale est bien moins à l'aise avec la trajectoire actuelle de l'inflation que ne l'avaient supposé les marchés — et peut-être ouverte à un resserrement supplémentaire de la politique plutôt qu'un assouplissement.

segments.src: ## Rate Bets Flip in a Matter of Hours
segments.tr: ## Les paris sur les taux se retournent en quelques heures

segments.src: The market reaction was swift.
segments.tr: La réaction du marché a été rapide.

segments.src: According to trading desks tracking interest-rate futures, the implied probability of a September rate hike jumped from around 35% to roughly 60% in the hours following the speech — a dramatic repricing for a market that, just a week earlier, had been leaning toward cuts.
segments.tr: Selon les bureaux de négociation suivant les contrats à terme sur les taux d'intérêt, la probabilité implicite d'une hausse de taux en septembre est passée d'environ 35% à environ 60% dans les heures suivant le discours — une refonte spectaculaire pour un marché qui, une semaine plus tôt, penchait vers des réductions.

segments.src: Equities moved in the opposite direction.
segments.tr: Les actions ont évolué dans la direction opposée.

segments.tr: ont baissé alors que les investisseurs assimilaient la perspective d'une politique monétaire plus restrictive et durable, les secteurs sensibles aux taux comme la technologie et l'immobilier étant parmi les plus durement touchés.

segments.src: Short-dated Treasury yields, which move closely with rate expectations, climbed as bond traders scrambled to adjust their positioning.
segments.tr: Les rendements des bons du Trésor à court terme, qui évoluent étroitement avec les attentes de taux, ont grimpé alors que les traders obligataires se sont empressés d'ajuster leur positionnement.

segments.src: Analysts described the move as one of the more abrupt sentiment shifts of the year, noting that it underscores how quickly market narratives can unravel when a single speech contradicts the prevailing consensus.
segments.tr: Les analystes ont décrit ce mouvement comme l'un des virages de sentiment les plus abruptes de l'année, notant qu'il souligne la rapidité avec laquelle les récits des marchés peuvent s'effondrer quand un seul discours contredit le consensus dominant.

segments.src: ## Why Warsh's Words Carry Extra Weight
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi les paroles de Warsh ont un poids supplémentaire

segments.src: Because the Fed chair's public remarks are scrutinized for clues about the future path of monetary policy, even carefully hedged language can move markets.
segments.tr: Parce que les remarques publiques du président de la Fed sont examinées à la loupe pour des indices sur la trajectoire future de la politique monétaire, même le langage soigneusement nuancé peut mouvoir les marchés.

segments.src: Investors and economists parse word choice, tone, and emphasis for signs of where the committee's thinking is heading — and Warsh's use of terms like "concerning" landed as a clear departure from the more measured, data-dependent language markets had grown used to.
segments.tr: Les investisseurs et économistes décortiquent le choix des mots, le ton et l'emphase pour des signes de la direction où la réflexion du comité se dirige — et l'utilisation par Warsh de termes comme « préoccupante » s'est avérée être un écart clair du langage plus mesuré et dépendant des données auquel les marchés s'étaient habitués.

segments.src: Some strategists cautioned against overreacting to a single speech, pointing out that the Fed's actual September decision will still hinge on incoming inflation and employment data released in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: Certains stratèges ont mis en garde contre une surréaction à un seul discours, soulignant que la décision réelle de septembre de la Fed dépendra toujours des données d'inflation et d'emploi à venir publiées dans les semaines à venir.

segments.src: Others argued that Warsh's tone reflects a genuine shift in the committee's internal debate, with more officials reportedly growing wary that inflation progress has stalled.
segments.tr: D'autres ont soutenu que le ton de Warsh reflète un véritable changement dans le débat interne du comité, avec de plus en plus de fonctionnaires qui, selon les rapports, deviennent prudents face à ce que les progrès de l'inflation se sont arrêtés.

segments.src: Traders are also expected to parse comments from other Fed officials in the coming days for signs of whether Warsh's view reflects broader consensus on the committee or a more personal emphasis.

segments.src: ## A Jackson Hole Surprise Nobody Priced In

segments.src: Heading into last week's Jackson Hole Economic Symposium, most traders had a simple story in their heads: inflation was cooling, the labor market was softening, and the Federal Reserve was on a glide path toward cutting interest rates at its September meeting.
segments.tr: 先週のジャクソンホール経済シンポジウムに向かう中、ほとんどのトレーダーは単純なシナリオを思い描いていました：インフレが冷え込んでおり、労働市場が軟化しており、連邦準備制度は9月の会合で金利を引き下げるための滑走路上にあるという話です。

segments.src: Futures markets reportedly had the odds of a rate hike at roughly 35%, with many desks treating that figure as a formality more than a real risk.
segments.tr: 先物市場は利上げの可能性を約35%と評価していたと報じられており、多くのデスクがこの数字を実際のリスクというより形式的な問題として扱っていました。

segments.src: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh tore that script up.
segments.tr: 連邦準備制度議長ケビン・ワーシュがそのシナリオを破り捨てた。

segments.src: In his keynote address at the symposium, Warsh struck a notably hawkish tone, describing recent inflation readings as "concerning" and telling the audience of central bankers, economists, and investors that the Fed "will have work to do" before it can declare victory over price pressures.
segments.tr: シンポジウムの基調講演で、ワーシュは注目すべきハト派的なトーンを打ち出し、最近のインフレ指標を「懸念される」と説明し、中央銀行家、エコノミスト、投資家の聴衆に、連邦準備制度が価格圧力の勝利を宣言する前に「対処すべき課題がある」と述べました。

segments.src: The remarks were widely interpreted as a signal that the central bank is far less comfortable with the current inflation trajectory than markets had assumed — and possibly open to tightening policy further rather than easing it.
segments.tr: この発言は、中央銀行が市場が想定していたよりも現在のインフレ軌道に大きく不安を感じており、政策を緩和するのではなく、さらに引き締める可能性があるというシグナルとして広く解釈されました。

segments.src: ## Rate Bets Flip in a Matter of Hours

segments.src: Investors and economists parse word choice, tone, and emphasis for signs of where the committee's thinking is heading — and Warsh's use of terms like "concerning" landed as a clear departure from the more measured, data-dependent language markets had grown used to.

segments.tr: Trong bài phát biểu chủ chốt tại hội thảo, Warsh sử dụng một tông điệu chủ chiến rõ ràng, mô tả các số liệu lạm phát gần đây là "đáng lo ngại" và nói với khán giả gồm các nhà ngân hàng trung ương, nhà kinh tế học, và các nhà đầu tư rằng Cục Dự trữ Liên bang "vẫn còn công việc phải làm" trước khi nó có thể tuyên bố chiến thắng lạm phát.

segments.src: The remarks were widely interpreted as a signal that the central bank is far less comfortable with the current inflation trajectory than markets had assumed — and possibly open to tightening policy further rather than easing it.
segments.tr: Những nhận xét đó được hiểu rộng rãi như một tín hiệu rằng ngân hàng trung ương cảm thấy ít thoải mái hơn nhiều với quỹ đạo lạm phát hiện tại so với những gì các thị trường đã giả định — và có thể sẵn sàng thắt chặt chính sách thêm nữa thay vì nới lỏng nó.

segments.src: ## Rate Bets Flip in a Matter of Hours
segments.tr: ## Cược Lãi Suất Lật Ngược Trong Vài Giờ

segments.src: The market reaction was swift.
segments.tr: Phản ứng thị trường rất nhanh.

segments.src: According to trading desks tracking interest-rate futures, the implied probability of a September rate hike jumped from around 35% to roughly 60% in the hours following the speech — a dramatic repricing for a market that, just a week earlier, had been leaning toward cuts.
segments.tr: Theo các bàn giao dịch theo dõi tương lai lãi suất, xác suất ngầm của một mức tăng lãi suất tháng Chín đã tăng từ khoảng 35% lên khoảng 60% trong những giờ sau bài phát biểu — một định giá lại kịch tính đối với một thị trường đã nghiêng về giảm lãi suất vài tuần trước.

segments.src: Equities moved in the opposite direction.
segments.tr: Cổ phiếu di chuyển theo hướng ngược lại.

segments.src: Major U.S.
segments.tr: U.S. lớn

segments.src: stock indexes slipped as investors digested the prospect of tighter-for-longer monetary policy, with rate-sensitive sectors such as technology and real estate said to be among the hardest hit.
segments.tr: chỉ số chứng khoán giảm khi các nhà đầu tư tiêu hóa triển vọng chính sách tiền tệ thắt chặt lâu dài hơn, với các lĩnh vực nhạy cảm với lãi suất như công nghệ và bất động sản được cho là bị ảnh hưởng nặng nhất.

segments.src: Short-dated Treasury yields, which move closely with rate expectations, climbed as bond traders scrambled to adjust their positioning.
segments.tr: Lợi suất Kho Bạc kỳ hạn ngắn, chuyển động chặt chẽ theo kỳ vọng lãi suất, tăng khi các nhà giao dịch trái phiếu vội vàng điều chỉnh vị trí.

segments.src: Analysts described the move as one of the more abrupt sentiment shifts of the year, noting that it underscores how quickly market narratives can unravel when a single speech contradicts the prevailing consensus.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích mô tả bước đi đó là một trong những sự thay đổi tâm lý đột ngột nhất trong năm, lưu ý rằng nó nhấn mạnh tốc độ nhanh chóng các câu chuyện thị trường có thể sụp đổ khi một bài phát biểu đơn lẻ mâu thuẫn với sự đồng thuận hiện hành.

segments.src: ## Why Warsh's Words Carry Extra Weight
segments.tr: ## Tại Sao Những Lời của Warsh Mang Trọng Lượng Thêm

segments.src: Because the Fed chair's public remarks are scrutinized for clues about the future path of monetary policy, even carefully hedged language can move markets.
segments.tr: Vì những nhận xét công khai của chủ tịch Cục Dự trữ Liên bang được kiểm tra chi tiết để tìm kiếm những manh mối về con đường tương lai của chính sách tiền tệ, ngay cả những ngôn ngữ được bảo vệ cẩn thận cũng có thể di chuyển thị trường.

segments.src: Investors and economists parse word choice, tone, and emphasis for signs of where the committee's thinking is heading — and Warsh's use of terms like "concerning" landed as a clear departure from the more measured, data-dependent language markets had grown used to.
segments.tr: Các nhà đầu tư và nhà kinh tế học phân tích sự lựa chọn từ, tông điệu và sự nhấn mạnh để tìm kiếm dấu hiệu về hướng suy nghĩ của ủy ban — và việc Warsh sử dụng các thuật ngữ như "đáng lo ngại" được coi là một sự khác biệt rõ ràng từ ngôn ngữ đo lường hơn, phụ thuộc dữ liệu mà các thị trường đã quen.

segments.src: Some strategists cautioned against overreacting to a single speech, pointing out that the Fed's actual September decision will still hinge on incoming inflation and employment data released in the weeks ahead.
segments.tr: Một số chiến lược gia cảnh báo lại việc phản ứng quá mức lên một bài phát biểu đơn lẻ, chỉ ra rằng quyết định tháng Chín thực tế của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang vẫn sẽ phụ thuộc vào dữ liệu lạm phát và tuyển dụng sắp tới được công bố trong những tuần tới.

segments.src: Others argued that Warsh's tone reflects a genuine shift in the committee's internal debate, with more officials reportedly growing wary that inflation progress has stalled.
segments.tr: Những người khác lập luận rằng tông điệu của Warsh phản ánh một sự thay đổi thực sự trong cuộc tranh luận nội bộ của ủy ban, với các quan chức hơn báo cáo ngày càng cảnh báo rằng tiến bộ lạm phát đã ngừng lại.

segments.src: ## What Investors Are Watching Next
segments.tr: ## Các Nhà Đầu Tư Đang Theo Dõi Cái Gì Tiếp Theo

segments.src: With rate-hike odds now nearly split with expectations for a hold, attention turns to the next batch of economic reports — particularly consumer price and jobs data — which could either reinforce or unwind the market's new hawkish lean.
segments.tr: Với tỷ lệ cược tăng lãi suất hiện tại gần như chia đôi với kỳ vọng về việc duy trì, chú ý chuyển đến loạt báo cáo kinh tế tiếp theo — đặc biệt là dữ liệu giá tiêu dùng và việc làm — những dữ liệu có thể tăng cường hoặc đảo ngược cách nhìn chủ chiến mới của thị trường.

segments.src: Traders are also expected to parse comments from other Fed officials in the coming days for signs of whether Warsh's view reflects broader consensus on the committee or a more personal emphasis.
segments.tr: Các nhà giao dịch cũng dự kiến sẽ phân tích các bình luận từ các quan chức Cục Dự trữ Liên bang khác trong những ngày tới để tìm kiếm dấu hiệu liệu quan điểm của Warsh phản ánh sự đồng thuận rộng hơn trên ủy ban hay một nhấn mạnh cá nhân hơn.

segments.src: For everyday investors, the episode is a reminder of how sensitive markets remain to Fed communication, and how quickly rate expectations — and portfolio values — can shift on a single speech.
segments.tr: Đối với các nhà đầu tư hàng ngày, tập này là một lời nhắc nhở về tính nhạy cảm của thị trường đối với giao tiếp Cục Dự trữ Liên bang, và tốc độ nhanh chóng kỳ vọng lãi suất — và giá trị danh mục — có thể thay đổi trên một bài phát biểu đơn lẻ.

segments.src: As always, market-implied probabilities are estimates based on trading activity, not guarantees of the Fed's eventual decision, and conditions can change quickly as new data arrives.
segments.tr: Như mọi khi, xác suất ngầm của thị trường là những ước tính dựa trên hoạt động giao dịch, không phải đảm bảo của quyết định cuối cùng của Cục Dự trữ Liên bang, và điều kiện có thể thay đổi nhanh chóng khi dữ liệu mới đến.
